recentItems.title: Cyclists protest Trump’s proposed overhaul of East Potomac Park
recentItems.description: Dozens in Washington, DC, protested on Saturday over President Donald Trump’s proposed overhaul of the 300-acre East Potomac Park, which could threaten a treasured bike path. CNN’s Kit Maher reports.

recentItems.title: ‘Hannibal Lecter’ is composing music
recentItems.description: At 88 years old, Sir Anthony Hopkins, who is known for his iconic role as Hannibal Lecter in The Silence of the Lambs, has composed his first music album.

recentItems.title: How Trump is secretly deporting migrants to Africa
recentItems.description:
The Trump administration has quietly struck deportation deals with at least 35 nations, often worth millions, according to Third Country Deportation. Isobel Yeung investigates where the money is going and what happens to migrants sent to a country they’ve never been to.
